proposals.evidence: Full CDIAL subsection 2 explicitly sets ciṭaka apart, with Prakrit ciḍiga bird, Hindi ciṛī/ciṛiyā bird, Bhojpuri ciraī and Awadhi ciraiyā. The selected Tharu/Danuwar ci-/tsi- bird responses match this front-vowel branch; retain source nasalization, affricate notation, final vowels and expanded feminine endings. The generic bird gloss remains unchanged, and local IA transmission is unresolved. Exact response: čĩrĩyə̃.
